purpose: validate the Windows collector buffering revision after B05-001 serial corruption before a new full B05 attempt

two_stage_protocol.stage_1: short collector session to confirm serial_buffer_configuration before the long test

acceptance: zero sequence gaps and zero missing sequence samples
maximum device_us sample gap is at most 30 ms
exactly one collector_stop control record is received
failure_disposition: If any criterion fails, preserve the raw file and diagnostics, do not launch B05 attempt002, and investigate the serial path again.
success_disposition: Passing this preflight is necessary but not sufficient for formal evidence. Create a new B05 attempt002 execution lock and rerun all global orders 253-315 without overwriting attempt001.
